reason: A billing and cost-analysis plugin that processes dsh session token usage, maintains cached OpenCode Go pricing, computes estimated costs, and presents results through tools and a web composer panel.

summaries.zh: 用于处理 dsh 会话用量、缓存 OpenCode Go 官方价格、计算预估费用并在工具和网页编辑器面板中展示账单分析。
summaries.en: Processes dsh session usage, caches OpenCode Go pricing, computes estimated costs, and presents billing analysis through tools and a web composer panel.

capabilities: Reads session usage records from dsh logs
Computes estimated costs from cached pricing data
Fetches and updates official pricing data through an external network request
Calls the configured default model for bill analysis
Exposes billing data through a web panel and composer UI line
